title: Existing-data ML experiment - pre-registered protocol
written: 2026-10-26, after the Phase A residual analysis of the production specifications and before any candidate was fitted

data.sources: only the Elexon files already in the project: DATASETS/{Oct25..Feb26}_Actual.json (FUELHH wind) and DATASETS1/{Oct25..Feb26}_Forecast.json (WINDFOR). No downloads, no other providers.
data.development: deliveries 2025-10-02 .. 2025-12-31 (decisions before January); the only data used to fit, tune and choose
data.january_2026: the application period (deliveries 2026-01-02 .. 2026-02-01); previously examined; evaluated once after selection
data.february_2026: previously examined (deliveries 2026-02-02 .. 2026-02-28); evaluated once after selection; not an untouched holdout
data.untouched_test: none exists in the existing data; no result here is a genuinely unseen test

decision_rule: forecast_mw = latest WINDFOR value published at or before 09:50 Europe/London on D-1; every feature uses only rows published by that cutoff
targets: regression: error_mw = forecast_mw - actual_mw (corrected forecast = forecast_mw - prediction); classification: shortfall = error_mw >= 1000 MW (fixed)

features.curve: spline(forecast_mw, quantile knots, degree 3, linear extrapolation) + hour_sin + hour_cos
features.wind_all: spline(forecast_mw) + the production features without lead_hours + hour_sin, hour_cos, err_last3h_mw, err_prev_day_mw, err_7d_mw, err_band_14d_mw, forecast_revision_24h_mw, forecast_day_max_mw, forecast_day_min_mw, forecast_day_std_mw, day_of_week, bank_holiday (median-imputed with missing indicators, scaled)
features.interactions: pairwise products of the scaled forecast_mw, hour_sin, hour_cos, err_last3h_mw, err_7d_mw, forecast_spread_mw, forecast_revision_mw

validation.static_training: every delivery up to 2 days before the block's first day
validation.rolling_training: for each validation day d: deliveries in [d-1-W, d-2] (all labels published before d's cutoff)
validation.preprocessing: imputation, scaling and spline knots fitted on training rows only

regression.R02_random_forest: RandomForestRegressor(300 trees, seed 42) on existing9; min_samples_leaf {20, 50, 100} x max_features {0.3, 0.5, 1.0} (production: 20, 0.5)
regression.R12_spline_level_hour: LinearRegression on the curve set; n_knots {3, 5, 7}
regression.R21_median_curve: QuantileRegressor(q=0.5, alpha=0) on the curve set; n_knots {3, 5, 7}
regression.R23_gbm_absolute: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss=absolute_error, 300 iterations, l2 1.0, increasing in forecast_mw, seed 42) on wind_all features (native missing values); learning_rate {0.03, 0.1} x max_leaf_nodes {7, 15} x min_samples_leaf {40, 100}
regression.R30_rolling_mean_bias: predicted error = mean error of the last W known days; W {7, 14, 28}
regression.R31_linear_plus_rolling_offset: R01 fitted on the training rows + mean R01 residual of the last W known days; W {7, 14, 28}
regression.R32_linear_rolling_refit: R01 refitted every day on the last W known days; W {14, 28}
regression.R33_median_curve_rolling_refit: R21 (5 knots) refitted every day on the last W known days; W {14, 28}

classification.C02_random_forest: RandomForestClassifier(300 trees, seed 42) on existing9; min_samples_leaf {20, 50, 100} x max_features {0.3, 0.5, 1.0} (production: 20, 0.5)
classification.C10_logistic_curve: LogisticRegression on the curve set; n_knots {3, 5, 7}
classification.C11_logistic_wind_all: LogisticRegression on wind_all; C {0.01, 0.1, 1, 10} x class_weight {none, balanced}
classification.C12_logistic_interactions: LogisticRegression on spline(forecast_mw) + the interactions set; C {0.1, 1}
classification.C13_gbm_classifier: HistGradientBoostingClassifier(300 iterations, l2 1.0, increasing in forecast_mw, seed 42) on wind_all features; learning_rate {0.03, 0.1} x max_leaf_nodes {7, 15} x min_samples_leaf {40, 100}
classification.C14_logistic_curve_rolling_refit: C10 (5 knots) refitted every day on the last W known days; W {14, 28}

selection.tuning: within each candidate family, the configuration with the best mean score over the 8 folds
selection.regression: the family winner with the lowest mean fold MAE
selection.classification: the family winner with the highest mean fold ROC-AUC; among winners within 0.005 of the best, the lowest mean fold Brier score
selection.nested_check: repeat tuning and selection on folds 1-4 only, then score the chosen configuration on folds 5-8 against the production specification
selection.rolling_retention: a rolling or drift-correcting candidate is reported as an improvement only if it beats its static counterpart on mean fold score and on at least 5 of 8 folds

ensembles.regression: members = the top 2 and top 3 family winners ranked on folds 1-4; equal weights or weights proportional to 1/MAE on folds 1-4; scored on folds 5-8
ensembles.classification: members = the top 2 and top 3 family winners ranked on folds 1-4; equal-weight or AUC-weighted average probability; scored on folds 5-8
ensembles.acceptance: accepted only if it beats the best single family (chosen on folds 1-4) on folds 5-8 overall and in at least 3 of the 4 late folds

classifier_extras.calibration: none vs Platt vs isotonic, fitted on the selected classifier's out-of-fold predictions from folds 1-4 and compared by Brier score on folds 5-8; the winner is refitted on all out-of-fold predictions
classifier_extras.thresholds: from development out-of-fold predictions only: (a) the highest threshold with recall >= 0.80; (b) the F1-maximising threshold

regression: error percentiles and share within 0.5 / 1 GW
classification: precision / recall / F1 at 0.5 and both thresholds
reporting.every_candidate: all family winners and all configurations are reported, including unsuccessful ones

evaluation_after_selection.periods: January 2026 and February 2026, each scored ONCE with the frozen selected models (trained on development data; rolling candidates refit only on data known at each cutoff)
evaluation_after_selection.compared_with: the official forecast and the production models' saved predictions (linear_by_level, logistic_by_level, random forests) on the same hours
evaluation_after_selection.uncertainty: 95% circular block bootstrap over whole days (3-day blocks, 5000 resamples) for the MAE and ROC-AUC differences vs the production defaults

recommendation_rule.strong: CV criteria met (selected; beats the production specification on mean and >= 5 of 8 folds; holds in the nested check) AND better than the production default in January and February with both 95% intervals excluding zero
recommendation_rule.suggestive: CV criteria met AND better than the production default in both January and February by point estimate
recommendation_rule.adoption: none automatic; any production change needs the owner's explicit approval
